lines.text: The angel says these words are faithful and true, and Jesus says He is coming soon.
John falls down to worship at the angel's feet, but the angel tells him to worship God.
The angel says to seal up the words of prophecy because the time is near, and Jesus brings His reward.

wrong_details.wrong: seal up the words of prophecy
wrong_details.true: Do not seal up the words of prophecy

lines.text: Jesus calls Himself the Alpha and the Omega, and the Root and Offspring of Saul, the bright Morning Star.
The Spirit and the bride say, "Come!" and the thirsty may drink the water of life freely.
